text:
Source-assisted reading of F-gh8b (Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 106). Every face of all six pieces was reread on the native images (canvas 0 = Stams_STA_Frg_106_01r06r, canvas 1 = Stams_STA_Frg_106_01v06v, both 7360 x 4912). Pieces 2 and 3 on canvas 0 are mounted upside down and were read rotated 180 degrees; their line numbers count from the top of the upright text. Expansions are in ( ), text lost at the cuts is in [ ], uncertain readings are marked ?, and [red] marks rubrication. After a source was found, the readings were checked again against it: the Augustine homily (PL 34), the collects (Gregorian sacramentary), the chants (Cantus Index) and the Vulgate. Lines not listed here were not relied on.
